# NU7 mainnet activation block

`mainnet-3543405.hex` is the public raw Zcash mainnet block at height 3,543,405, obtained with `getblock(getblockhash(3543405), 0)`.

- Block hash: `0000000000246a2b1fecb3f465770894d146f6b7044e46b13ffb65e57e4ccd4a`
- SHA-256 of decoded bytes: `500ddf6f064bed4491775b9ef62f631155c4b6a248ba50c279a78f3092eb70f9`
- Consensus branch: `77190ad9` (NU7).

The decoder test checks the activation boundary, block identity, claimed height, transaction Merkle root, transaction branch IDs and complete byte consumption. An empty viewing-key set exercises parsing without associating any on-chain transaction with a receiver. Synthetic encrypted fixtures in `crypto.rs` separately exercise incoming-note decryption.
